"use strict";

/**
 * PHOENIX EMPIRE — LEDGER SPINE (MONOLITH)
 * Version: V7-CHAINFIX-1
 *
 * What this provides (Phase 0):
 * - Worker gate: x-sovereign-key auth + payload size gate
 * - Durable Object (Sovereign): append-only ledger
 *   - deterministic canonical JSON
 *   - SHA-256 hash sealing
 *   - prev_hash linkage
 *   - parent_block_id = last_block_id (TRUE chain)
 *   - monotonic nonce (replay defense)
 *   - idempotency by command_id (24h TTL)
 *   - Make.com webhook relay (NON-FATAL)
 *
 * Routes:
 * - GET  /health
 * - POST /ledger/append
 * - GET  /ledger/head
 * - GET  /ledger/block/:blockId
 */

export default {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const pathname = url.pathname;

    // Public health check (no auth) — avoids false negatives in monitors
    if (request.method === "GET" && pathname === "/health") {
      return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });
    }

    // Everything else is sovereign-gated
    const key = request.headers.get("x-sovereign-key");
    if (!key || key !== env.SOVEREIGN_KEY) {
      return new Response("UNAUTHORIZED", { status: 401 });
    }

    // Hard payload cap (100KB)
    const cl = request.headers.get("content-length");
    if (cl && Number(cl) > 102400) return new Response("PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE", { status: 413 });

    // Route to DO (Sovereign)
    const id = env.PHOENIX_DO.idFromName("PHOENIX_EMPIRE_CORE");
    const stub = env.PHOENIX_DO.get(id);
    return stub.fetch(request);
  }
};

export class PhoenixDO {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }

  // Deterministic canonical JSON (deep, sorted keys)
  canonicalJSON(obj) {
    if (obj === null) return "null";
    if (obj === undefined) return "undefined";
    if (typeof obj !== "object") return JSON.stringify(obj);
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) return "[" + obj.map(v => this.canonicalJSON(v)).join(",") + "]";
    const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
    const pairs = keys.map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + this.canonicalJSON(obj[k]));
    return "{" + pairs.join(",") + "}";
  }

  async sha256Hex(str) {
    const data = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
    return [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  }

  json(obj, status = 200, extraHeaders = {}) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(obj), {
      status,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...extraHeaders }
    });
  }

  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const pathname = url.pathname;

    // Phase 0 routes
    if (request.method === "POST" && pathname === "/ledger/append") return this.handleAppend(request);
    if (request.method === "GET" && pathname === "/ledger/head") return this.handleHead();
    if (request.method === "GET" && pathname.startsWith("/ledger/block/")) {
      const blockId = pathname.split("/").pop();
      return this.handleGetBlock(blockId);
    }

    // Allow /health passthrough in DO too (safe)
    if (request.method === "GET" && pathname === "/health") {
      return new Response("OK", { status: 200 });
    }

    return new Response("NOT_FOUND", { status: 404 });
  }

  async handleHead() {
    const head = await this.state.storage.get("head");
    if (!head) return this.json({ error: "NO_BLOCKS" }, 404);
    return this.json(head, 200);
  }

  async handleGetBlock(blockId) {
    const block = await this.state.storage.get(`block:${blockId}`);
    if (!block) return this.json({ error: "BLOCK_NOT_FOUND", block_id: blockId }, 404);
    return this.json(block, 200);
  }

  async handleAppend(request) {
    // Defensive size gate (repeat inside DO)
    const cl = request.headers.get("content-length");
    if (cl && Number(cl) > 102400) return new Response("PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE", { status: 413 });

    let incoming;
    try {
      incoming = await request.json();
    } catch {
      return new Response("MALFORMED_JSON", { status: 400 });
    }

    // Fail-closed schema minimums
    if (!incoming || typeof incoming !== "object") return new Response("INVALID_BODY", { status: 400 });
    if (!incoming.block_id) return new Response("MISSING_block_id", { status: 400 });
    if (incoming.nonce === undefined || typeof incoming.nonce !== "number") return new Response("MISSING_nonce", { status: 400 });
    if (!incoming.protocol || incoming.protocol !== "PHOENIX/1.0") return new Response("BAD_PROTOCOL", { status: 400 });
    if (!incoming.command_id) return new Response("MISSING_command_id", { status: 400 });

    // 1) IDEMPOTENCY (priority)
    const idemKey = `idem:${incoming.command_id}`;
    const cached = await this.state.storage.get(idemKey);
    if (cached) {
      return this.json(cached, 200, { "x-cache": "HIT" });
    }

    // 2) NONCE (monotonic)
    const lastNonce = (await this.state.storage.get("last_nonce")) || 0;
    if (incoming.nonce <= lastNonce) {
      return this.json(
        { error: "NONCE_REPLAY_DETECTED", last_nonce: lastNonce, incoming_nonce: incoming.nonce },
        409
      );
    }

    // 3) CHAIN CONTEXT
    const prevHash = (await this.state.storage.get("last_hash")) || null;
    const lastBlockId = (await this.state.storage.get("last_block_id")) || null;

    // TRUE parent pointer:
    // - B0 parent = null
    // - otherwise parent = last_block_id
    const parentBlockId =
      incoming.block_id === "B0"
        ? null
        : (incoming.parent_block_id ?? lastBlockId ?? "B0");

    // Hash material = incoming + chain context (prev_hash + parent_block_id), excluding mutable fields
    const hashMaterial = {
      ...incoming,
      parent_block_id: parentBlockId,
      prev_hash: prevHash
    };
    delete hashMaterial.hash;
    delete hashMaterial.seal;
    delete hashMaterial.sealed_at;

    const canonical = this.canonicalJSON(hashMaterial);
    const hash = await this.sha256Hex(canonical);

    const sealed = {
      ...incoming,
      parent_block_id: parentBlockId,
      prev_hash: prevHash,
      hash,
      seal: "SEALED",
      sealed_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    // Persist (append-only by block_id key; caller must ensure unique block_id policy)
    await this.state.storage.put(`block:${sealed.block_id}`, sealed);
    await this.state.storage.put("head", sealed);
    await this.state.storage.put("last_hash", hash);
    await this.state.storage.put("last_nonce", incoming.nonce);
    await this.state.storage.put("last_block_id", sealed.block_id);

    // Idempotency cache (24h)
    await this.state.storage.put(idemKey, sealed, { expirationTtl: 24 * 60 * 60 });

    // Relay to Make (non-fatal)
    this.relayToMake(sealed).catch(() => {});

    return this.json(sealed, 200, { "x-cache": "MISS" });
  }

  async relayToMake(sealed) {
    if (!this.env.MAKE_WEBHOOK) return;

    // Minimal mirror payload (Sheets-friendly)
    const payload = {
      ledger_id: this.env.LEDGER_ID || sealed.ledger_id,
      block_id: sealed.block_id,
      parent_block_id: sealed.parent_block_id,
      command_id: sealed.command_id,
      timestamp_utc: sealed.timestamp_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
      author: sealed.author,
      mode: sealed.mode,
      block_type: sealed.block_type,
      nonce: sealed.nonce,
      protocol: sealed.protocol,
      prev_hash: sealed.prev_hash,
      hash: sealed.hash,
      payload: JSON.stringify(sealed.payload ?? {})
    };

    await fetch(this.env.MAKE_WEBHOOK, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
  }
}

      margin-top:10px;
    }

    button{
      appearance:none;
      border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.35);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(168,85,247,.22), rgba(0,0,0,.18));
      color:var(--text);
      border-radius:14px;
      padding:10px 12px;
      font-weight:700;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition: transform .08s ease, box-shadow .08s ease, border-color .08s ease;
      outline:none;
    }
    button:hover{
      transform: scale(1.02);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168,85,247,.25);
      border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.45);
    }
    button:active{transform: translateY(2px) scale(1.01)}
    button:focus{box-shadow:var(--focus)}

    .btnGold{
      border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.45);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245,158,11,.18), rgba(0,0,0,.18));
    }

    .mutedNote{
      font-size:12px;
      color:var(--muted);
      margin-top:8px;
      line-height:1.35;
    }

    .out{
      margin-top:10px;
      min-height:0;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:10px;
    }

    .out textarea{
      font-family:var(--mono);
      min-height:160px;
      resize:vertical;
      white-space:pre;
    }

    .small{
      font-size:12px;
      color:var(--muted);
      margin:0;
    }

    .rightStack{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:12px;
      min-height:0;
    }

    .divider{
      height:1px;
      background:rgba(168,85,247,.12);
      margin:10px 0;
    }

    .statusbar{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      padding:10px 12px;
      border-radius:var(--radius);
      background:var(--panel);
      border:1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      font-size:12px;
      color:var(--muted);
    }

    .statusLeft{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center}
    .statusDot{
      width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:99px;
      background:rgba(245,158,11,.75);
      box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,.20);
    }

    .kbd{
      font-family:var(--mono);
      padding:3px 8px;
      border-radius:999px;
      border:1px solid var(--border2);
      background:rgba(0,0,0,.20);
      color:rgba(229,231,235,.80);
    }

    .err{
      border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.6) !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245,158,11,.20) !important;
    }
    .ok{
      border-color: rgba(168,85,247,.45) !important;
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px){
      .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      header{flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start}
      .chips{justify-content:flex-start}
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div class="wrap">

    <header>
      <div class="title">
        <h1>PHOENIX EMPIRE – COMMAND STATION</h1>
        <p class="sub">Phase 1: manual copy/paste • no network • no secrets • Gospel 444</p>
      </div>
      <div class="chips">
        <div class="chip">PROTOCOL: PHOENIX RISING V8.1</div>
        <div class="chip">MODE: SCRIBE/ANALYST</div>
        <div class="chip">LEDGER: PREVIEW ONLY</div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main class="grid">

      <!-- LEFT: Magic Chat Console -->
      <section class="panel" aria-label="Magic Chat Console">
        <h2>Magic Chat Console</h2>

        <div class="twoCol">
          <div>
            <label for="targetModel">Target model</label>
            <select id="targetModel">
              <option>Claude</option>
              <option selected>GPT</option>
              <option>Gemini</option>
              <option>Perplexity</option>
              <option>Local Phoenix Drone</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label for="priority">Priority</label>
            <select id="priority">
              <option>Low</option>
              <option selected>Normal</option>
              <option>High</option>
              <option>Critical</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="twoCol" style="margin-top:10px;">
          <div>
            <label for="expectedArtifactType">Expected output (type)</label>
            <select id="expectedArtifactType">
              <option selected>Code</option>
              <option>Audit</option>
              <option>Strategy</option>
              <option>Flow</option>
              <option>Prompt</option>
              <option>Other</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label for="expectedArtifactText">Expected output (details)</label>
            <input id="expectedArtifactText" placeholder="e.g., command-station.html + 3 JSON specs" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-top:10px;">
          <label>Mode</label>
          <div class="radioRow">
            <label class="radio">
              <input type="radio" name="mode" value="SCRIBE" checked />
              <span>SCRIBE</span>
            </label>
            <label class="radio">
              <input type="radio" name="mode" value="ANALYST" />
              <span>ANALYST</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-top:10px;">
          <label for="task">Task</label>
          <textarea id="task" placeholder="Write the builder task exactly. Keep it copy/paste ready."></textarea>
        </div>

        <div class="btnRow">
          <button id="btnGenerate" class="btnGold">Generate Handoff</button>
          <button id="btnCopyHandoff">Copy Handoff</button>
          <button id="btnResetHandoff">Reset</button>
        </div>

        <p class="mutedNote">
          Output format is G11-style. Phase 1 = you paste this block into the target model manually.
        </p>

        <div class="out">
          <label for="handoffOut">Generated handoff (read-only)</label>
          <textarea id="handoffOut" readonly spellcheck="false"></textarea>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- RIGHT: Ledger builder + Drone commands -->
      <section class="rightStack" aria-label="Right Pane">

        <section class="panel">
          <h2>Ledger Payload Builder</h2>

          <div class="twoCol">
            <div>
              <label for="operationType">Operation type</label>
              <select id="operationType">
                <option selected>INTENT</option>
                <option>EXECUTION</option>
                <option>AUDIT</option>
                <option>DECISION</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label for="actor">Actor</label>
              <input id="actor" value="AGENT-100" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style="margin-top:10px;">
            <label for="summary">Summary</label>
            <input id="summary" placeholder="Short human-readable description (recommended ≤ 140 chars)" />
          </div>

          <div style="margin-top:10px;">
            <label for="payloadJson">Payload (JSON object)</label>
            <textarea id="payloadJson" placeholder='{"example":"Put raw operation details here"}'></textarea>
          </div>

          <div class="btnRow">
            <button id="btnBuildPayload" class="btnGold">Build Append Payload</button>
            <button id="btnCopyPayload">Copy JSON</button>
            <button id="btnCopyCanonical">Copy Canonical String</button>
          </div>

          <p class="mutedNote">
            Hash/nonce/signature placeholders only. Backend (Phoenix Empire) will add cryptography + networking later.
          </️
          </p>

          <div class="divider"></div>

          <p class="small" id="parseStatus">Payload parse: waiting…</p>

          <label for="appendOut" style="margin-top:8px;">Append payload preview (read-only)</label>
          <textarea id="appendOut" readonly spellcheck="false" style="font-family:var(--mono); min-height:220px;"></textarea>

          <label for="canonicalOut" style="margin-top:8px;">Canonical string (sorted keys, no whitespace)</label>
          <textarea id="canonicalOut" readonly spellcheck="false" style="font-family:var(--mono); min-height:120px;"></textarea>
        </section>

        <section class="panel">
          <h2>Drone Commands (Phase 1: Templates)</h2>

          <p class="small" style="margin:0 0 10px 0;">
            These buttons generate ready-to-paste command snippets. No network.
          </p>

          <div class="btnRow">
            <button data-drone="manychat">ManyChat: Lead Flow Handoff</button>
            <button data-drone="roblox">Roblox: Telemetry Handoff</button>
            <button data-drone="ledger">Ledger: Append Spec Handoff</button>
          </div>

          <label for="droneOut" style="margin-top:10px;">Generated template</label>
          <textarea id="droneOut" readonly spellcheck="false" style="font-family:var(--mono); min-height:220px;"></textarea>

          <div class="btnRow">
            <button id="btnCopyDrone">Copy Template</button>
          </div>
        </section>

      </section>
    </main>

    <footer class="statusbar" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <div class="statusLeft">
        <span class="statusDot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span id="statusText">READY — Manual mode. No network calls.</span>
        <span class="kbd">CTRL</span><span class="kbd">C</span><span class="small">copy outputs</span>
      </div>
      <div id="timeText">—</div>
    </footer>

  </div>

  <script>
    "use strict";

    // -----------------------------
    // Helpers (safe by default)
    // -----------------------------
    function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
    function nowIsoUtc(){ return new Date().toISOString(); }

    function setStatus(msg){
      $("statusText").textContent = msg;
    }

    async function copyToClipboard(text){
      // Clipboard API requires secure context + user gesture on many browsers.
      // Fallback: select + execCommand.
      try{
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        return true;
      }catch(_){
        try{
          const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
          ta.value = text;
          ta.style.position = "fixed";
          ta.style.left = "-9999px";
          document.body.appendChild(ta);
          ta.focus();
          ta.select();
          const ok = document.execCommand("copy");
          document.body.removeChild(ta);
          return ok;
        }catch(__){
          return false;
        }
      }
    }

    function stableStringify(value){
      // Deterministic JSON stringify:
      // - Objects: keys sorted lexicographically
      // - Arrays: order preserved
      // - No whitespace
      if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return JSON.stringify(value);
      if (Array.isArray(value)){
        return "[" + value.map(stableStringify).join(",") + "]";
      }
      const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
      return "{" + keys.map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + stableStringify(value[k])).join(",") + "}";
    }

    function readMode(){
      const nodes = document.querySelectorAll("input[name='mode']");
      for (const n of nodes){ if (n.checked) return n.value; }
      return "SCRIBE";
    }

    function expectedOutput(){
      const t = $("expectedArtifactType").value;
      const d = $("expectedArtifactText").value.trim();
      return d ? (t + " — " + d) : t;
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // G11 handoff generator
    // -----------------------------
    function buildHandoff(){
      const targetModel = $("targetModel").value;
      const task = $("task").value.trim();
      const mode = readMode();
      const priority = $("priority").value;
      const exp = expectedOutput();

      const safeTask = task || "(NO_TASK_PROVIDED — WRITE TASK IN THE CONSOLE)";
      const block =
[HANDOFF TO ${targetModel}]
AUTHORITY: AGENT-100 (Michael Hobbs)
PROTOCOL: PHOENIX RISING V8.1
CONTEXT: Operation Phoenix Memory / EMPIRE_1B_VND

TASK: ${safeTask}
MODE: ${mode}
PRIORITY: ${priority}
VALIDATION: Zero-drift required. Fail-closed on ambiguity.
EXPECTED OUTPUT: ${exp}

RETURN TO: AGENT-99 (Primary Interface)
CURRENT LEDGER STATE: https://phoenix-empire.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/ledger/read
;
      return block;
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Ledger append payload builder (Phase 1 = preview only)
    // -----------------------------
    function buildAppendPayload(){
      const operation_type = $("operationType").value;
      const actor = $("actor").value.trim() || "UNKNOWN_ACTOR";
      const summary = ($("summary").value || "").trim();

      const raw = ($("payloadJson").value || "").trim();
      let payloadObj = null;

      const status = $("parseStatus");
      const payloadField = $("payloadJson");

      payloadField.classList.remove("err","ok");

      if (!raw){
        payloadObj = {};
        status.textContent = "Payload parse: empty -> {}";
        payloadField.classList.add("ok");
      } else {
        try{
          payloadObj = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (payloadObj === null || typeof payloadObj !== "object" || Array.isArray(payloadObj)){
            throw new Error("Payload must be a JSON object (not null/array).");
          }
          status.textContent = "Payload parse: OK";
          payloadField.classList.add("ok");
        }catch(e){
          status.textContent = "Payload parse: ERROR — " + (e && e.message ? e.message : "Invalid JSON");
          payloadField.classList.add("err");
          payloadObj = null;
        }
      }

      const envelope = {
        parent_hash: "<PARENT_HASH_PLACEHOLDER>",
        hash: "<SHA256_OF_CANONICAL_PAYLOAD_PLACEHOLDER>",
        operation_type,
        actor,
        summary: summary || "(NO_SUMMARY_PROVIDED)",
        payload: payloadObj || { "__PARSE_ERROR__": true },
        timestamp: nowIsoUtc(),
        nonce: "<AUTO: PLACEHOLDER_NONCE>",
        signature: "<ED25519_SIGNATURE_PLACEHOLDER>"
      };

      const canonical = stableStringify(envelope);
      return { envelope, canonical, ok: payloadObj !== null };
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Drone template generator
    // -----------------------------
    function droneTemplate(kind){
      const base =
[HANDOFF TO ${$("targetModel").value}]
AUTHORITY: AGENT-100 (Michael Hobbs)
PROTOCOL: PHOENIX RISING V8.1
CONTEXT: Operation Phoenix Memory / EMPIRE_1B_VND

MODE: ${readMode()}
PRIORITY: ${$("priority").value}
VALIDATION: Zero-drift required. Fail-closed on ambiguity.

RETURN TO: AGENT-99 (Primary Interface)
CURRENT LEDGER STATE: https://phoenix-empire.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/ledger/read
;

      if (kind === "manychat"){
        return base + 
TASK: Convert the provided manychat_recruitment_drone_spec.json into ManyChat flows (comment keyword + DM keyword) and define the Make.com webhook payload contract for ledger events (LEAD_CREATED / LEAD_QUALIFIED / CLASS_BOOKED).
EXPECTED OUTPUT: Flow + webhook contract + field map (VN + EN copy).
;
      }
      if (kind === "roblox"){
        return base + 
TASK: Implement the roblox_drone_spec.json integration plan: define event payloads (player_id/session_id/quest_id), batching rules, and ledger mapping. Keep identifiers pseudonymous.
EXPECTED OUTPUT: Event payload schemas + batching/retry notes + ledger append examples.
;
      }
      return base + 
TASK: Produce phoenix-ledger-spec.json: schema (append-only, parent_hash, hash placeholders, timestamp UTC ISO8601, nonce, signature placeholder) plus examples for INTENT/EXECUTION/AUDIT/DECISION.
EXPECTED OUTPUT: JSON Schema + examples.
;
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Wire up UI
    // -----------------------------
    function tickClock(){
      $("timeText").textContent = "UTC: " + nowIsoUtc();
    }
    setInterval(tickClock, 1000);
    tickClock();

    $("btnGenerate").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const out = buildHandoff();
      $("handoffOut").value = out;
      setStatus("HANDOFF GENERATED — ready to copy/paste.");
    });

    $("btnCopyHandoff").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      const text = $("handoffOut").value || buildHandoff();
      $("handoffOut").value = text;
      const ok = await copyToClipboard(text);
      setStatus(ok ? "HANDOFF COPIED." : "COPY FAILED — select text manually.");
    });

    $("btnResetHandoff").addEventListener("click", () => {
      $("task").value = "";
      $("expectedArtifactText").value = "";
      $("handoffOut").value = "";
      setStatus("RESET — Magic Chat Console cleared.");
    });

    $("btnBuildPayload").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const { envelope, canonical, ok } = buildAppendPayload();
      $("appendOut").value = JSON.stringify(envelope, null, 2);
      $("canonicalOut").value = canonical;
      setStatus(ok ? "APPEND PAYLOAD BUILT — preview only." : "APPEND PAYLOAD BUILT — payload JSON has errors.");
    });

    $("btnCopyPayload").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      const text = $("appendOut").value || JSON.stringify(buildAppendPayload().envelope, null, 2);
      $("appendOut").value = text;
      const ok = await copyToClipboard(text);
      setStatus(ok ? "APPEND JSON COPIED." : "COPY FAILED — select text manually.");
    });

    $("btnCopyCanonical").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      const text = $("canonicalOut").value || buildAppendPayload().canonical;
      $("canonicalOut").value = text;
      const ok = await copyToClipboard(text);
      setStatus(ok ? "CANONICAL STRING COPIED." : "COPY FAILED — select text manually.");
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("button[data-drone]").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const kind = btn.getAttribute("data-drone");
        const t = droneTemplate(kind);
        $("droneOut").value = t.trim() + "\n";
        setStatus("DRONE TEMPLATE GENERATED — ready to paste.");
      });
    });

    $("btnCopyDrone").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      const text = $("droneOut").value || "";
      const ok = await copyToClipboard(text);
      setStatus(ok ? "DRONE TEMPLATE COPIED." : "COPY FAILED — select text manually.");
    });

    // Auto-build payload preview on load (non-destructive)
    (() => {
      const { envelope, canonical } = buildAppendPayload();
      $("appendOut").value = JSON.stringify(envelope, null, 2);
      $("canonicalOut").value = canonical;
      $("handoffOut").value = "";
      $("droneOut").value = "";
      setStatus("READY — Manual mode. No network calls.");
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

2.2 phoenix-ledger-spec.json (schema + examples)
{
  "schema_name": "phoenix_ledger_append_v1",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "time_standard": "ISO8601_UTC",
  "immutability": "append_only",
  "description": "Next-gen ledger append envelope (Phase 1: builder prepares payload; backend seals hash+signature).",
  "json_schema": {
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "$id": "phoenix-ledger-append-v1.schema.json",
    "title": "Phoenix Ledger Append Envelope v1",
    "type": "object",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "required": [
      "parent_hash",
      "hash",
      "operation_type",
      "actor",
      "summary",
      "payload",
      "timestamp",
      "nonce",
      "signature"
    ],
    "properties": {
      "parent_hash": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 256,
        "description": "Hash of prior head (or GENESIS). Placeholder allowed in Phase 1."
      },
      "hash": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 256,
        "description": "SHA-256 of canonical envelope string. Placeholder allowed in Phase 1."
      },
      "operation_type": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": ["INTENT", "EXECUTION", "AUDIT", "DECISION"]
      },
      "actor": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 128,
        "description": "Canonical actor identifier (e.g., AGENT-100, AGENT-99, DRONE_MANYCHAT, DRONE_ROBLOX)."
      },
      "summary": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 280
      },
      "payload": {
        "type": "object",
        "description": "Operation details as an object. Arrays are allowed only inside nested fields, not as top-level payload."
      },
      "timestamp": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "date-time",
        "description": "UTC ISO8601 timestamp (e.g., 2026-01-20T03:21:00.000Z)."
      },
      "nonce": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 8,
        "maxLength": 256,
        "description": "Replay-defense nonce. Placeholder allowed in Phase 1."
      },
      "signature": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 2048,
        "description": "Ed25519 signature over canonical envelope. Placeholder allowed in Phase 1."
      },
      "meta": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true,
        "description": "Optional metadata (schema_version, environment, source_system, etc.)."
      }
    }
  },
  "canonicalization": {
    "method": "stable_json_stringify",
    "rules": [
      "Object keys sorted lexicographically at all depths",
      "Arrays preserve order",
      "No whitespace",
      "UTF-8 encoding"
    ],
    "note": "Hash/signature must be computed over the canonical string of the full envelope."
  },
  "examples": {
    "INTENT": {
      "parent_hash": "<PARENT_HASH_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "hash": "<SHA256_OF_CANONICAL_PAYLOAD_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "operation_type": "INTENT",
      "actor": "AGENT-100",
      "summary": "Request: build Command Station Phase 1 UI",
      "payload": {
        "artifact_targets": [
          "command-station.html",
          "phoenix-ledger-spec.json",
          "manychat_recruitment_drone_spec.json",
          "roblox_drone_spec.json"
        ],
        "phase": "PHASE_1_MANUAL",
        "constraints": {
          "no_network": true,
          "no_secrets": true,
          "vanilla_js": true
        }
      },
      "timestamp": "<AUTO_UTC_ISO8601>",
      "nonce": "<AUTO_NONCE_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "signature": "<ED25519_SIGNATURE_PLACEHOLDER>"
    },
    "EXECUTION": {
      "parent_hash": "<PARENT_HASH_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "hash": "<SHA256_OF_CANONICAL_PAYLOAD_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "operation_type": "EXECUTION",
      "actor": "AGENT-99",
      "summary": "Generated G11 handoff for builder model",
      "payload": {
        "target_model": "GPT",
        "mode": "SCRIBE",
        "priority": "High",
        "expected_output": "Code — command-station.html + 3 JSON specs"
      },
      "timestamp": "<AUTO_UTC_ISO8601>",
      "nonce": "<AUTO_NONCE_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "signature": "<ED25519_SIGNATURE_PLACEHOLDER>"
    },
    "AUDIT": {
      "parent_hash": "<PARENT_HASH_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "hash": "<SHA256_OF_CANONICAL_PAYLOAD_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "operation_type": "AUDIT",
      "actor": "AGENT-97",
      "summary": "Audit: spec consistency + drift risks",
      "payload": {
        "findings": [
          { "id": "A-001", "severity": "WARN", "note": "Canonicalization must be defined for nested keys." },
          { "id": "A-002", "severity": "INFO", "note": "Phase 1 must remain no-network to prevent premature auth drift." }
        ]
      },
      "timestamp": "<AUTO_UTC_ISO8601>",
      "nonce": "<AUTO_NONCE_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "signature": "<ED25519_SIGNATURE_PLACEHOLDER>"
    },
    "DECISION": {
      "parent_hash": "<PARENT_HASH_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "hash": "<SHA256_OF_CANONICAL_PAYLOAD_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "operation_type": "DECISION",
      "actor": "AGENT-100",
      "summary": "Decision: proceed with Phase 1 manual copy/paste",
      "payload": {
        "decision": "PROCEED",
        "phase": "PHASE_1_MANUAL",
        "notes": "No network calls until ledger writer is confirmed."
      },
      "timestamp": "<AUTO_UTC_ISO8601>",
      "nonce": "<AUTO_NONCE_PLACEHOLDER>",
      "signature": "<ED25519_SIGNATURE_PLACEHOLDER>"
    }
  }
}

2.3 manychat_recruitment_drone_spec.json (machine-readable state machine + ledger mapping)
{
  "drone_name": "DRONE_MANYCHAT_RECRUITMENT_V1",
  "channels": ["FacebookPage", "InstagramOptional"],
  "localization": {
    "default_language": "vi",
    "supported_languages": ["vi", "en"]
  },
  "entry_points": [
    {
      "type": "comment_keyword",
      "keyword": "BUSINESS",
      "description": "Trigger when user comments BUSINESS on a post/ad.",
      "campaign_id": "DEFAULT_CAMPAIGN"
    },
    {
      "type": "dm_keyword",
      "keyword": "TIGER",
      "description": "Trigger when user DMs TIGER to the page.",
      "campaign_id": "DEFAULT_CAMPAIGN"
    }
  ],
  "data_model": {

"use strict";

/**
 * PhoenixDO — Sovereign Ledger (Hardened V2)
 *
 * Guarantees:
 * - Append-only blocks (stored by block_id)
 * - True chain: parent_block_id = last_block_id (or null for B0)
 * - prev_hash = last_hash (or null for B0)
 * - Monotonic nonce per ledger_id (nonce must be > last_nonce for that ledger)
 * - Timestamp bounds: +/- 5 minutes from server time
 * - Idempotency by command_id (24h TTL): returns identical sealed response
 * - Deterministic canonicalization + SHA-256 of canonical envelope (excluding hash/seal)
 *
 * Notes:
 * - Webhook relay is BEST-EFFORT (non-fatal) to keep ledger authoritative.
 * - Signature verification can be added later behind a strict toggle.
 */

export class PhoenixDO {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
    this.MAX_BYTES = 102400; // 100KB
    this.SKEW_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes
    this.IDEM_TTL = 24 * 60 * 60; // 24h
    this.PROTOCOL = "PHOENIX/1.0";
    this.SCHEMA_VERSION = "2.0.0";
  }

  // --- Deterministic canonical JSON (deep, sorted keys, arrays preserved) ---
  stableStringify(v) {
    if (v === null) return "null";
    const t = typeof v;
    if (t === "number" || t === "boolean") return JSON.stringify(v);
    if (t === "string") return JSON.stringify(v);
    if (t !== "object") return JSON.stringify(String(v));

    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      return "[" + v.map((x) => this.stableStringify(x)).join(",") + "]";
    }

    const keys = Object.keys(v).sort();
    return (
      "{" +
      keys
        .map((k) => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + this.stableStringify(v[k]))
        .join(",") +
      "}"
    );
  }

  async sha256Hex(str) {
    const data = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
    return [...new Uint8Array(buf)]
      .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join("");
  }

  json(obj, status = 200, extraHeaders = {}) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(obj), {
      status,
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...extraHeaders },
    });
  }

  bad(status, code, details = {}) {
    return this.json({ ok: false, code, ...details }, status);
  }

  // --- Storage keys are ledger-scoped ---
  k(ledgerId, suffix) {
    return `L:${ledgerId}:${suffix}`;
  }

  // --- Core router ---
  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);

    if (request.method === "POST" && url.pathname === "/ledger/append") {
      return this.handleAppend(request);
    }
    if (request.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/ledger/head") {
      return this.handleHead(url);
    }
    if (request.method === "GET" && url.pathname.startsWith("/ledger/block/")) {
      const blockId = url.pathname.split("/").pop();
      return this.handleGetBlock(url, blockId);
    }
    if (request.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/ledger/verify") {
      return this.handleVerify(url);
    }

    return new Response("NOT_FOUND", { status: 404 });
  }

  // --- GET head: supports ?ledger_id=... ---
  async handleHead(url) {
    const ledgerId = url.searchParams.get("ledger_id") || this.env.LEDGER_ID;
    if (!ledgerId) return this.bad(400, "MISSING_LEDGER_ID");

    const head = await this.state.storage.get(this.k(ledgerId, "head"));
    if (!head) return this.bad(404, "NO_BLOCKS", { ledger_id: ledgerId });
    return this.json({ ok: true, head }, 200);
  }

  // --- GET block: supports ?ledger_id=... ---
  async handleGetBlock(url, blockId) {
    const ledgerId = url.searchParams.get("ledger_id") || this.env.LEDGER_ID;
    if (!ledgerId) return this.bad(400, "MISSING_LEDGER_ID");
    if (!blockId) return this.bad(400, "MISSING_BLOCK_ID");

    const block = await this.state.storage.get(this.k(ledgerId, `block:${blockId}`));
    if (!block) return this.bad(404, "BLOCK_NOT_FOUND", { ledger_id: ledgerId, block_id: blockId });
    return this.json({ ok: true, block }, 200);
  }

  // --- Verify: checks B0→head linkage by walking parent pointers (bounded) ---
  async handleVerify(url) {
    const ledgerId = url.searchParams.get("ledger_id") || this.env.LEDGER_ID;
    if (!ledgerId) return this.bad(400, "MISSING_LEDGER_ID");

    const head = await this.state.storage.get(this.k(ledgerId, "head"));
    if (!head) return this.bad(404, "NO_BLOCKS", { ledger_id: ledgerId });

    // bounded walk
    const MAX_WALK = 2048;
    let cur = head;
    let steps = 0;
    while (cur) {
      steps++;
      if (steps > MAX_WALK) return this.bad(500, "VERIFY_TOO_DEEP", { steps });

      if (cur.block_id === "B0") {
        // Genesis must have null parent/prev_hash
        if (cur.parent_block_id !== null) return this.bad(500, "BAD_GENESIS_PARENT");
        if (cur.prev_hash !== null) return this.bad(500, "BAD_GENESIS_PREV_HASH");
        return this.json({ ok: true, ledger_id: ledgerId, head: head.block_id, steps }, 200);
      }

      const parentId = cur.parent_block_id;
      if (!parentId) return this.bad(500, "MISSING_PARENT_POINTER", { block_id: cur.block_id });

      const parent = await this.state.storage.get(this.k(ledgerId, `block:${parentId}`));
      if (!parent) return this.bad(500, "PARENT_NOT_FOUND", { block_id: cur.block_id, parent_block_id: parentId });

      // prev_hash must match parent's hash
      if (cur.prev_hash !== parent.hash) {
        return this.bad(500, "BAD_PREV_HASH_LINK", {
          block_id: cur.block_id,
          expected_prev_hash: parent.hash,
          got_prev_hash: cur.prev_hash,
        });
      }

      cur = parent;
    }

    return this.bad(500, "VERIFY_FAILED_UNKNOWN");
  }

  // --- Append ---
  async handleAppend(request) {
    // Size gate (best-effort)
    const cl = request.headers.get("content-length");
    if (cl && Number(cl) > this.MAX_BYTES) return this.bad(413, "PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE");

    let incoming;
    try {
      incoming = await request.json();
    } catch {
      return this.bad(400, "MALFORMED_JSON");
    }

    // Hard schema gates (fail-closed)
    if (!incoming || typeof incoming !== "object") return this.bad(400, "INVALID_BODY");
    if (!incoming.ledger_id || typeof incoming.ledger_id !== "string") return this.bad(400, "MISSING_ledger_id");
    if (!incoming.block_id || typeof incoming.block_id !== "string") return this.bad(400, "MISSING_block_id");
    if (typeof incoming.nonce !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(incoming.nonce)) return this.bad(400, "MISSING_nonce");
    if (!incoming.command_id || typeof incoming.command_id !== "string") return this.bad(400, "MISSING_command_id");
    if (!incoming.protocol || incoming.protocol !== this.PROTOCOL) return this.bad(400, "BAD_PROTOCOL", { expected: this.PROTOCOL });

    // timestamp_utc is REQUIRED, must be ISO string (date-time parseable)
    if (!incoming.timestamp_utc || typeof incoming.timestamp_utc !== "string") return this.bad(400, "MISSING_timestamp_utc");
    const ts = Date.parse(incoming.timestamp_utc);
    if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) return this.bad(400, "BAD_timestamp_utc");

    // Timestamp bounds
    const now = Date.now();
    if (Math.abs(now - ts) > this.SKEW_MS) {
      return this.bad(400, "TIMESTAMP_SKEW", {
        server_utc: new Date(now).toISOString(),
        received_utc: incoming.timestamp_utc,
        max_skew_ms: this.SKEW_MS,
      });
    }

    const ledgerId = incoming.ledger_id;

    // Idempotency FIRST: same command_id returns same sealed response
    const idemKey = this.k(ledgerId, `idem:${incoming.command_id}`);
    const cached = await this.state.storage.get(idemKey);
    if (cached) return this.json({ ok: true, sealed: cached }, 200, { "x-cache": "HIT" });

    // Nonce monotonic per ledger_id
    const lastNonce = (await this.state.storage.get(this.k(ledgerId, "last_nonce"))) || 0;
    if (incoming.nonce <= lastNonce) {
      return this.bad(409, "NONCE_REPLAY", { last_nonce: lastNonce, incoming_nonce: incoming.nonce });
    }

    // Determine chain pointers
    const lastHash = (await this.state.storage.get(this.k(ledgerId, "last_hash"))) || null;
    const lastBlockId = (await this.state.storage.get(this.k(ledgerId, "last_block_id"))) || null;

    const isGenesis = incoming.block_id === "B0";
    if (isGenesis) {
      if (lastBlockId !== null || lastHash !== null || lastNonce !== 0) {
        return this.bad(409, "GENESIS_ALREADY_EXISTS");
      }
    }

    const parent_block_id = isGenesis ? null : lastBlockId;
    const prev_hash = isGenesis ? null : lastHash;

    if (!isGenesis && (!parent_block_id || !prev_hash)) {
      return this.bad(409, "CHAIN_NOT_INITIALIZED", { hint: "Append B0 first." });
    }

    // Build hash material (exclude hash + seal fields, include chain pointers + schema)
    const hashMaterial = {
      schema_version: this.SCHEMA_VERSION,
      ...incoming,
      parent_block_id,
      prev_hash,
    };
    delete hashMaterial.hash;
    delete hashMaterial.seal;
    delete hashMaterial.sealed_at;

    const canonical = this.stableStringify(hashMaterial);
    const hash = await this.sha256Hex(canonical);

    const sealed = {
      schema_version: this.SCHEMA_VERSION,
      ...incoming,
      parent_block_id,
      prev_hash,
      hash,
      seal: "SEALED",
      sealed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    // Persist (append-only by block_id)
    await this.state.storage.put(this.k(ledgerId, `block:${sealed.block_id}`), sealed);
    await this.state.storage.put(this.k(ledgerId, "head"), sealed);
    await this.state.storage.put(this.k(ledgerId, "last_hash"), hash);
    await this.state.storage.put(this.k(ledgerId, "last_block_id"), sealed.block_id);
    await this.state.storage.put(this.k(ledgerId, "last_nonce"), incoming.nonce);

    // Idempotency cache 24h
    await this.state.storage.put(idemKey, sealed, { expirationTtl: this.IDEM_TTL });

    // Webhook relay (non-fatal)
    this.relayToMake(sealed).catch(() => {});

    return this.json({ ok: true, sealed }, 200, { "x-cache": "MISS" });
  }

  async relayToMake(sealed) {
    if (!this.env.MAKE_WEBHOOK) return;

    const payload = {
      ledger_id: this.env.LEDGER_ID || sealed.ledger_id,
      block_id: sealed.block_id,
      parent_block_id: sealed.parent_block_id,
      command_id: sealed.command_id,
      timestamp_utc: sealed.timestamp_utc,
      sealed_at: sealed.sealed_at,
      author: sealed.author,
      mode: sealed.mode,
      block_type: sealed.block_type,
      nonce: sealed.nonce,
      protocol: sealed.protocol,
      prev_hash: sealed.prev_hash,
      hash: sealed.hash,
      payload: JSON.stringify(sealed.payload || {}),
      schema_version: sealed.schema_version,
    };

    const r = await fetch(this.env.MAKE_WEBHOOK, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    // Do not fail ledger append; but you *can* optionally log a WARN block later.
    if (!r.ok) return;
  }
}

/**

    if (url.pathname.startsWith("/ledger/")) {
      const key = request.headers.get("x-sovereign-key");

    if (url.pathname === "/" && request.method === "GET") {
      return new Response("PHOENIX_OK", { status: 200 });
    }

    return new Response("NOT_FOUND", { status: 404 });
  },
};

// phoenix_do_v3_canon.js
// PHOENIX LEDGER — V3 (CUTTING EDGE)
// Immutable • Verifiable • Restart-Safe • Fail-Closed

export class PhoenixLedgerDO {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
  }

  async fetch(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/append" && req.method === "POST") {
      return this.append(await req.json());
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/read") {
      return this.read();
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/ledger/verify") {
      return this.verify();
    }

    return new Response("NOT_FOUND", { status: 404 });
  }

  async append(input) {
    return this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      const {
        operation_type,
        actor,
        summary,
        payload,
        nonce,
        timestamp,
        signature
      } = input;

      if (!operation_type || !actor || !nonce || !timestamp) {
        return this.fail("MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELDS");
      }

      const meta = await this.state.storage.get("meta") || {
        height: 0,
        head_hash: null,
        nonces: {}
      };

      // Nonce enforcement (per actor)
      const lastNonce = meta.nonces[actor] ?? 0;
      if (nonce <= lastNonce) {
        return this.fail("NONCE_REPLAY");
      }

      const envelope = {
        parent_hash: meta.head_hash,
        height: meta.height + 1,
        operation_type,
        actor,
        summary,
        payload,
        timestamp,
        nonce
      };

      const canonical = canonicalStringify(envelope);
      const hash = await sha256(canonical);

      const event = {
        event_id: hash,
        hash,
        signature: signature || "<UNSIGNED>",
        ...envelope
      };

      // Persist
      await this.state.storage.put(`block:${event.height}`, event);

      meta.height = event.height;
      meta.head_hash = hash;
      meta.nonces[actor] = nonce;

      // Checkpoint every 100 blocks
      if (event.height % 100 === 0) {
        await this.state.storage.put(
          `checkpoint:${event.height}`,
          { root: hash, height: event.height }
        );
      }

      await this.state.storage.put("meta", meta);

      return new Response(JSON.stringify(event, null, 2), { status: 200 });
    });
  }

  async read() {
    const meta = await this.state.storage.get("meta");
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2));
  }

  async verify() {
    const meta = await this.state.storage.get("meta");
    if (!meta) return this.fail("NO_LEDGER");

    let prev = null;

    for (let i = 1; i <= meta.height; i++) {
      const block = await this.state.storage.get(`block:${i}`);
      if (!block) return this.fail(`MISSING_BLOCK_${i}`);
      if (block.parent_hash !== prev) {
        return this.fail(`CHAIN_BREAK_AT_${i}`);
      }
      prev = block.hash;
    }

    if (prev !== meta.head_hash) {
      return this.fail("HEAD_MISMATCH");
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      status: "OK",
      height: meta.height,
      head_hash: meta.head_hash
    }, null, 2));
  }

  fail(code) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: "FAIL", code }), { status: 400 });
  }
}

/* ================= HELPERS ================= */

async function sha256(str) {
  const buf = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
  return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

function canonicalStringify(obj) {
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return "[" + obj.map(canonicalStringify).join(",") + "]";
  }
  if (obj && typeof obj === "object") {
    return "{" + Object.keys(obj).sort()
      .map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + canonicalStringify(obj[k]))
      .join(",") + "}";
  }
  return JSON.stringify(obj);
}

// phoenix_do_v3_hybrid.js
// PHOENIX LEDGER V3 HYBRID — Cutting-Edge + Performance
// Combines V2 indexed queries + V3 chain integrity improvements

export class PhoenixLedgerV3 {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
    
    this.state.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      await this.initializeDatabase();
    });
  }

  async initializeDatabase() {
    // Blocks table with V3 improvements
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blocks (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        height INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        event_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        parent_hash TEXT,
        hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        timestamp_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
        nonce INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        actor TEXT NOT NULL,
        operation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT,
        payload TEXT NOT NULL,
        signature TEXT,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())
      )
    );

    // V2 Indexes (performance)
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_blocks_timestamp ON blocks(timestamp_utc)
    );
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_blocks_operation_type ON blocks(operation_type)
    );
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_blocks_nonce ON blocks(nonce)
    );
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_blocks_actor ON blocks(actor)
    );
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_blocks_height ON blocks(height)
    );

    // V3 Chain metadata
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chain_meta (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())
      )
    );

    // V3 Checkpoints (Merkle acceleration)
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checkpoints (
        height INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        merkle_root TEXT NOT NULL,
        timestamp_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())
      )
    );

    // V2 Idempotency
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency (
        command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()),
        expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    );
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_idempotency_expires ON idempotency(expires_at)
    );

    // V2 Audit trail
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_trail (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        action TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor TEXT NOT NULL,
        timestamp_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
        metadata TEXT
      )
    );
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_timestamp ON audit_trail(timestamp_utc)
    );
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_actor ON audit_trail(actor)
    );

    // V3 Per-actor nonce tracking (forensics only, not enforcement)
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS actor_nonces (
        actor TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        last_nonce INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())
      )
    );

    // Initialize chain metadata
    await this.initializeChainMeta();
  }

  async initializeChainMeta() {
    const existing = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT key FROM chain_meta WHERE key IN ('height', 'head_hash', 'current_nonce')
    ).toArray();

    const keys = new Set(existing.map(r => r.key));

    if (!keys.has('height')) {
      await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
        INSERT INTO chain_meta (key, value) VALUES ('height', '0')
      );
    }
    if (!keys.has('head_hash')) {
      await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
        INSERT INTO chain_meta (key, value) VALUES ('head_hash', 'null')
      );
    }
    if (!keys.has('current_nonce')) {
      await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
        INSERT INTO chain_meta (key, value) VALUES ('current_nonce', '0')
      );
    }
  }

  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const path = url.pathname;
    const method = request.method;

    try {
      // Health check
      if (path === "/health" && method === "GET") {
        return this.handleHealth();
      }

      // V3 Append (enhanced)
      if (path === "/ledger/append" && method === "POST") {
        return await this.handleAppend(request);
      }

      // V2 Batch append
      if (path === "/ledger/batch-append" && method === "POST") {
        return await this.handleBatchAppend(request);
      }

      // V2 Read
      if (path === "/ledger/read" && method === "GET") {
        return await this.handleRead(request);
      }

      // V3 Verify (NEW)
      if (path === "/ledger/verify" && method === "GET") {
        return await this.handleVerify(request);
      }

      // V2 Timeline
      if (path === "/ledger/timeline" && method === "GET") {
        return await this.handleTimeline(request);
      }

      // V2 Audit
      if (path === "/ledger/audit" && method === "GET") {
        return await this.handleAudit(request);
      }

      // V2 Block by ID
      if (path.startsWith("/ledger/block/") && method === "GET") {
        const eventId = path.split("/")[3];
        return await this.handleGetBlock(eventId);

      // V2 Stats + V3 chain health
      if (path === "/ledger/stats" && method === "GET") {
        return await this.handleStats();
      }

      // V3 Checkpoints (NEW)
      if (path === "/ledger/checkpoints" && method === "GET") {
        return await this.handleCheckpoints();
      }

      return new Response("Not Found", { status: 404 });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error("DO Error:", error);
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ 
          ok: false, 
          error: error.message,
          stack: error.stack,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        }),
        { 
          status: 500,
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
        }
      );
    }
  }

  handleHealth() {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ 
        ok: true,

        ],

  async handleAppend(request) {

          }),
          { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
        );
      }
    }

    // Get chain metadata (V3 enhancement)
    const meta = await this.getChainMeta();
    const currentNonce = parseInt(meta.current_nonce);
    const currentHeight = parseInt(meta.height);
    const headHash = meta.head_hash === 'null' ? null : meta.head_hash;

    // Enforce global monotonic nonce (V7 CANON)
    if (nonce <= currentNonce) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ 
          ok: false,

          provided_nonce: nonce
        }),

      );
    }

    // Build block envelope (V3 structure)
    const envelope = {
      parent_hash: headHash,

      operation_type,

    };

    const hash = await this.sha256(canonical);
    const eventId = hash; // V3: event_id = hash for simplicity

    const block = {
      height: envelope.height,
      event_id: eventId,
      parent_hash: envelope.parent_hash,

      timestamp_utc: envelope.timestamp_utc,
      nonce,
      actor,
      operation_type,
      summary: envelope.summary,
      payload: envelope.payload,
      signature: signature || null
    };

    // Insert block
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(

       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?),
      block.height,
      block.event_id,
      block.parent_hash,
      block.hash,
      block.timestamp_utc,
      block.nonce,
      block.actor,
      block.operation_type,
      block.summary,
      block.payload,
      block.signature
    );

    // Update chain metadata (V3)
    await this.updateChainMeta('height', block.height.toString());
    await this.updateChainMeta('head_hash', block.hash);
    await this.updateChainMeta('current_nonce', block.nonce.toString());

    // Update actor nonce (V3 forensics)
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO actor_nonces (actor, last_nonce, updated_at)
       VALUES (?, ?, unixepoch()),

      nonce
    );

    // Create checkpoint every 100 blocks (V3)
    if (block.height % 100 === 0) {
      await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
        INSERT INTO checkpoints (height, merkle_root, timestamp_utc)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?),
        block.height,
        block.hash,

      );
    }

    // Store idempotency record (V2 feature, 24 hour TTL)
    if (command_id) {
      const expiresAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + (24 * 60 * 60);
      await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
        INSERT INTO idempotency (command_id, event_id, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?),
        command_id,
        block.event_id,

      );
    }

    // Add audit trail entry (V2 feature)
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      INSERT INTO audit_trail (event_id, action, actor, timestamp_utc, metadata)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?),
      block.event_id,
      'APPEND',
      actor,
      block.timestamp_utc,
      JSON.stringify({ operation_type, command_id, height: block.height })

    // Cleanup expired idempotency records

    // Send webhook (V2 feature, non-blocking)
    if (this.env.MAKE_WEBHOOK) {
      this.sendWebhook(block).catch(err =>

      );
    }

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ 
        ok: true, 
        block: {
          ...block,
          payload: this.tryParseJSON(block.payload)
        }
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleVerify(request) {
    // V3 NEW: Full chain integrity verification
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const quick = url.searchParams.get("quick") === "true";

    const meta = await this.getChainMeta();
    const currentHeight = parseInt(meta.height);
    const headHash = meta.head_hash === 'null' ? null : meta.head_hash;

    if (currentHeight === 0) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          ok: true,
          status: "EMPTY_CHAIN",
          height: 0
        }),
        { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // Quick verify: just check head matches last block
    if (quick) {
      const lastBlock = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
        SELECT hash FROM blocks WHERE height = ?,
        currentHeight
      ).toArray();

      if (lastBlock.length === 0) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({
            ok: false,
            error: "HEAD_MISSING",
            expected_height: currentHeight
          }),
          { status: 500, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
        );
      }

      if (lastBlock[0].hash !== headHash) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({
            ok: false,
            error: "HEAD_MISMATCH",
            meta_head: headHash,
            actual_head: lastBlock[0].hash
          }),
          { status: 500, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
        );
      }

      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          ok: true,
          status: "QUICK_VERIFY_PASS",
          height: currentHeight,
          head_hash: headHash
        }),
        { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // Full verify: walk entire chain
    let prevHash = null;
    let errors = [];

    for (let h = 1; h <= currentHeight; h++) {
      const blocks = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
        SELECT * FROM blocks WHERE height = ?,
        h
      ).toArray();

      if (blocks.length === 0) {
        errors.push({ height: h, error: "MISSING_BLOCK" });
        continue;
      }

      const block = blocks[0];

      // Check parent linkage
      if (block.parent_hash !== prevHash) {
        errors.push({ 
          height: h, 
          error: "PARENT_HASH_MISMATCH",
          expected: prevHash,
          actual: block.parent_hash
        });
      }

      // Verify hash computation
      const envelope = {
        parent_hash: block.parent_hash,
        height: block.height,
        operation_type: block.operation_type,
        actor: block.actor,
        summary: block.summary,
        payload: block.payload,
        timestamp_utc: block.timestamp_utc,
        nonce: block.nonce
      };
      const canonical = this.canonicalStringify(envelope);
      const computedHash = await this.sha256(canonical);

      if (computedHash !== block.hash) {
        errors.push({
          height: h,
          error: "HASH_MISMATCH",
          expected: computedHash,
          actual: block.hash
        });
      }

      prevHash = block.hash;
    }

    // Check final head matches
    if (prevHash !== headHash) {
      errors.push({
        error: "FINAL_HEAD_MISMATCH",
        meta_head: headHash,
        computed_head: prevHash
      });
    }

    if (errors.length > 0) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          ok: false,
          status: "VERIFY_FAILED",
          height: currentHeight,
          errors
        }),
        { status: 500, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        status: "FULL_VERIFY_PASS",
        height: currentHeight,
        head_hash: headHash,
        blocks_verified: currentHeight
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleBatchAppend(request) {
    // V2 feature maintained
    const body = await request.json();
    const { blocks } = body;

    if (!Array.isArray(blocks) || blocks.length === 0) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "blocks array required" }),
        { status: 400, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    const results = [];
    const errors = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
      try {
        const blockRequest = new Request(request.url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: request.headers,
          body: JSON.stringify(blocks[i])
        });
        
        const response = await this.handleAppend(blockRequest);
        const result = await response.json();
        
        if (result.ok) {
          results.push(result.block);
        } else {
          errors.push({ index: i, error: result.error });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        errors.push({ index: i, error: error.message });
      }
    }

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ 
        ok: errors.length === 0,
        succeeded: results.length,
        failed: errors.length,
        blocks: results,
        errors
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleRead(request) {
    // V2 feature maintained
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get("limit") || "1000");
    const offset = parseInt(url.searchParams.get("offset") || "0");

    const blocks = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT * FROM blocks ORDER BY height ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?,
      limit,
      offset
    ).toArray();

    const meta = await this.getChainMeta();

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        blocks: blocks.map(b => ({
          ...b,
          payload: this.tryParseJSON(b.payload)
        })),
        chain_meta: meta,
        count: blocks.length,
        limit,
        offset
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleTimeline(request) {
    // V2 feature maintained
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const startDate = url.searchParams.get("start");
    const endDate = url.searchParams.get("end");
    const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get("limit") || "100");

    let query = SELECT * FROM blocks WHERE 1=1;
    let params = [];

    if (startDate) {
      query +=  AND timestamp_utc >= ?;
      params.push(startDate);
    }

    if (endDate) {
      query +=  AND timestamp_utc <= ?;
      params.push(endDate);
    }

    query +=  ORDER BY timestamp_utc DESC LIMIT ?;
    params.push(limit);

    const blocks = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(query, ...params).toArray();

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        blocks: blocks.map(b => ({
          ...b,
          payload: this.tryParseJSON(b.payload)
        })),
        count: blocks.length,
        filters: { startDate, endDate, limit }
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleAudit(request) {
    // V2 feature maintained
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const actor = url.searchParams.get("actor");
    const action = url.searchParams.get("action");
    const startDate = url.searchParams.get("start");
    const endDate = url.searchParams.get("end");
    const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get("limit") || "100");

    let query = SELECT * FROM audit_trail WHERE 1=1;
    let params = [];

    if (actor) {
      query +=  AND actor = ?;
      params.push(actor);
    }

    if (action) {
      query +=  AND action = ?;
      params.push(action);
    }

    if (startDate) {
      query +=  AND timestamp_utc >= ?;
      params.push(startDate);
    }

    if (endDate) {
      query +=  AND timestamp_utc <= ?;
      params.push(endDate);
    }

    query +=  ORDER BY timestamp_utc DESC LIMIT ?;
    params.push(limit);

    const auditEntries = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(query, ...params).toArray();

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        audit_entries: auditEntries.map(e => ({
          ...e,
          metadata: this.tryParseJSON(e.metadata)
        })),
        count: auditEntries.length,
        filters: { actor, action, startDate, endDate, limit }
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleGetBlock(eventId) {
    // V2 feature maintained
    const block = await this.getBlockByEventId(eventId);
    
    if (!block) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: "Block not found" }),
        { status: 404, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ ok: true, block }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleStats() {
    // V2 + V3 hybrid
    const stats = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT 
        COUNT(*) as total_blocks,
        MIN(timestamp_utc) as first_block_time,
        MAX(timestamp_utc) as last_block_time,
        COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type) as operation_types,
        COUNT(DISTINCT actor) as unique_actors
      FROM blocks
    ).toArray();

    const opTypeCounts = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT operation_type, COUNT(*) as count
      FROM blocks
      GROUP BY operation_type
      ORDER BY count DESC
    ).toArray();

    const checkpointCount = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM checkpoints
    ).toArray();

    const meta = await this.getChainMeta();

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        stats: {
          ...stats[0],
          chain_meta: meta,
          checkpoints: checkpointCount[0].count,
          operations: opTypeCounts
        },
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  async handleCheckpoints() {
    // V3 NEW
    const checkpoints = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT * FROM checkpoints ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 100
    ).toArray();

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        checkpoints,
        count: checkpoints.length
      }),
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }

  // Helper methods

  async getChainMeta() {
    const rows = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT key, value FROM chain_meta WHERE key IN ('height', 'head_hash', 'current_nonce')
    ).toArray();

    const meta = {};
    rows.forEach(r => {
      meta[r.key] = r.value;
    });

    return meta;
  }

  async updateChainMeta(key, value) {
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      UPDATE chain_meta SET value = ?, updated_at = unixepoch() WHERE key = ?,
      value,
      key
    );
  }

  async getBlockByEventId(eventId) {
    const blocks = await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      SELECT * FROM blocks WHERE event_id = ?,
      eventId
    ).toArray();

    if (blocks.length === 0) return null;

    const block = blocks[0];
    return {
      ...block,
      payload: this.tryParseJSON(block.payload)
    };
  }

  canonicalStringify(obj) {
    // V3 improved canonical serialization
    if (obj === null) return "null";
    if (obj === undefined) return "null";
    if (typeof obj === "boolean") return obj ? "true" : "false";
    if (typeof obj === "number") return String(obj);
    if (typeof obj === "string") return JSON.stringify(obj);
    
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      return "[" + obj.map(item => this.canonicalStringify(item)).join(",") + "]";
    }
    
    if (typeof obj === "object") {
      const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
      return "{" + keys
        .map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ":" + this.canonicalStringify(obj[k]))
        .join(",") + "}";
    }
    
    return "null";
  }

  async sha256(str) {
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const data = encoder.encode(str);
    const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
    const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
    return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  }

  tryParseJSON(str) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(str);
    } catch {
      return str;
    }
  }

  async cleanupExpiredIdempotency() {
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    await this.state.storage.sql.exec(
      DELETE FROM idempotency WHERE expires_at < ?,
      now
    );
  }

  async sendWebhook(block) {
    if (!this.env.MAKE_WEBHOOK) return;

    try {
      await fetch(this.env.MAKE_WEBHOOK, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          event: "block_appended",
          block: {
            ...block,
            payload: this.tryParseJSON(block.payload)
          },
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        })
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Webhook send failed:", error);
    }
  }
}

// src/index.js
// PHOENIX LEDGER V3.1 — MONOLITH (Worker + Durable Object)
// Mode: FAIL-CLOSED / DO-SOVEREIGN / SQL-INDEXED / GLOBAL-NONCE / IDEMPOTENCY
// Notes:
// - Worker is a stateless gate (auth + routing). Durable Object is sovereign.
// - Hash is SHA-256(canonical(envelope)) where envelope excludes hash/event_id.
// - Timestamp bounds: ±5 minutes (server-side) to reduce replay/clock abuse.

"use strict";

/* =========================================================================================
 * 0) Worker Gate
 * ======================================================================================= */

export default {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const path = url.pathname;

    // Public health check (no auth)
    if (path === "/health" && request.method === "GET") {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          ok: true,
          service: "phoenix-ledger",
          version: "v3.1",
          time_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        }),
        { headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // Everything else requires sovereign key
    const key = request.headers.get("x-sovereign-key");
    if (!key || key !== env.SOVEREIGN_KEY) {
      return new Response("UNAUTHORIZED", { status: 401 });
    }

    // Route to Durable Object (single sovereign instance)
    const id = env.PHOENIX_DO.idFromName("PHOENIX_EMPIRE_CORE");
    const stub = env.PHOENIX_DO.get(id);
    return stub.fetch(request);
  },
};
